name: AccountTeamPermissions
title: Blocks/Account/AccountTeamPermissions
summary: Teams and their permissions. The primary is the Teams and permissions list: a `PageHeader` with Create Team, the view-table controls row (`PropertyFilter`, Refresh and Download CSV as `IconButton`s, `CollectionPreferences`) over a `Table` of teams (name as `TableCellLink` with a square `Avatar` and the description, permissions as `TableCellTags` with `+N`, members, `TableCellStatus`, and `TableCellActions` with Edit, Duplicate and Delete behind a `ConfirmDialog`), on one `useCollection`. The CreateTeam variant is the permission matrix: General (name, description), a Permissions table grouped by area with View and Edit columns, a group `Checkbox` that is indeterminate when partly checked, filter, Select all and Clear, Edit implying View, and a `SaveBar`. The EditTeam variant fills it with a saved team and adds Members (add from the account's users, remove) and Delete team. The list and its states are a page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot; CreateTeam and EditTeam are full pages in the creation frame of `create/create-page` (a `AppHeader` with Back to Teams and permissions, no rail).

variants.name: CreateTeam
variants.summary: The Create Team page in the creation frame (a `AppHeader` with Back to Teams and permissions, the brand and a breadcrumb; no rail): name and description, the View and Edit permission matrix as a `Table` grouped by area with group checkboxes (a small `EmptyState` with Clear filter when the filter matches nothing), filter, Select all and Clear, a status Switch, and Cancel and Create in a centered SaveBar floating over the bottom of the form; errors on the name field and above the matrix.

variants.name: EditTeam
variants.summary: The Edit Team page in the same creation frame: the CreateTeam form filled with a saved team, a Members section (Add member `Combobox` over the account's users with Add, each member with Remove), Delete team behind a `ConfirmDialog`, and the same centered `SaveBar`, which offers Discard and Save changes only once something changed.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No team yet: the heading and a flush EmptyState with Create Team replace the controls row and the table.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the controls row and the table's loading rows.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The teams did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the table; Retry loads them.
